pains.title: Pain → solution → result
pains.subtitle: We don't sell software — we sell management results. Three key changes leadership will see:

items.title: Finds the profit you're losing
items.pain: Where profit leaks remains unclear even at month-end, after all the spreadsheets are merged.
items.solution: Batch cost, expense lines and plan vs actual are calculated in one place, in real time.
items.result: Profit and loss are visible every day — unnecessary costs surface immediately.

items.title: Responds to orders fast
items.pain: Order intake, purchasing, inventory and production live in separate tools — customers wait.
items.solution: Sales order → purchasing → warehouse → production → delivery as one continuous chain.
items.result: Order-to-shipment time drops and customers get a reliable delivery date.

items.title: Gives leadership a clear picture
items.pain: Answering “what's happening right now?” means calling several departments.
items.solution: Interactive dashboards for finance, sales, production, inventory, HR and tasks.
items.result: Decisions are made on numbers, not gut feeling — and faster.

items.a: It's staged by company size: first practical results within 2–8 weeks. Your demo environment is ready within 1 business day of your request.

Leave a request — a specialist contacts you and opens a separate demo environment just for you: filled with sample data, all modules enabled, free for 14 days. It's not a shared showroom — you can enter and test your own data.

items.q: Can we keep our current Excel processes?
items.a: Yes. Data is imported from Excel, a parallel-run model is used during the transition, and your team moves over painlessly.

items.q: Can it connect to our accounting software?
items.a: Yes. tahsinERP integrates with external systems via API — accounting, banks, marketplaces and more.

items.q: Where is our data stored, and is it secure?
items.a: A separate database per company, encrypted connections (HTTPS), role-based permissions and regular backups. If needed, the system can also be installed on your own server.
Orders are processed faster, customers get a reliable delivery date, and Telegram takes orders 24/7 — increasing sales volume and conversion.
